--- stdout

--- stderr

Unknown command: 'frobnicate'

$ fastexec exec
exit: 1
--- stdout
Usage: fastexec exec [host] <command>
--- stderr


$ fastexec get
exit: 1
--- stdout
Usage: fastexec get <remote_path> [local_path] [host]
--- stderr


$ fastexec put local.txt
exit: 1
--- stdout
Usage: fastexec put <local_path> <remote_path> [host]
--- stderr


$ fastexec sql
exit: 1

--- stderr


$ fastexec job start
exit: 1
--- stdout

--- stderr


$ fastexec daemon foo

--- stdout
